title: An interface
description:
An **interface** is a class made only of pure virtual functions: a contract with no implementation.

1. Write `ILogger` with a virtual destructor and one pure virtual function, `virtual void log(std::string_view message) = 0;`
2. Write `MemoryLogger`, which implements it by storing every message in a vector, and offers `const std::vector<std::string>& lines() const`.
3. Write `void runJob(ILogger& logger, int steps)`, which logs `"start"`, then `"step 1"`, `"step 2"` ... up to `steps`, then `"done"`.

`runJob` depends only on the interface, so it would work unchanged with a logger that writes to a file, the console or the network.
